snippets.ELOISE_RACE_01: Hello $$name$$! Do you remember me? I'm Eloise. The Pokopets came to Panfu with me.
snippets.ELOISE_RACE_02: The way I see it they're very happy here. That's lovely!
snippets.ELOISE_RACE_03: They also train quite actively. Before this moment you couldn't choose the opponent for your Pokopet. That will change now!
snippets.ELOISE_RACE_04: From now on you can decide which Pokopet you'd like to compete against!
snippets.ELOISE_RACE_05: Just click on the Pokopet with which you'd like to start a race. If the owner of the Pokopet allows it the race may begin!
snippets.ELOISE_RACE_06: Have you got a suitable opponent in mind? Well then, break a leg... I mean: Good luck! And see you soon.
snippets.LOADINGTEXT_04: The Pokopets are getting on their marks...
snippets.LOADINGTEXT_05: The Pokopets are waiting for the signal...
snippets.PETRACE_TT_DICES: shows how many steps a Pokopet takes per one round.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_POSITIONVIEW: shows the Pokopet's position on the race track
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_AINTOVERYET: The race ain't over yet! Both Pokopets will be teleported back a bit.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_BARRIER: Places a huge obstacle in front of your opponent.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_BIGJUMP: Your Pokopet will hop over the next obstacle with a gigantic leap.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_BOOST: Your Pokopet will fly like a canon ball! This will cost health points though!
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_COUNTERSPELL: With a counterspell your opponent's next special ability will lose its effect.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_EVILSPIRITS: Evil spirits hit the brakes on your opponent.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_GLUEBOMB: Gluebomb makes your opponent stick to the floor for a while.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_ICEBEAM: Icebeam freezes your opponent up for a moment.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_LIFELINE: Let yourself be pulled up to your opponent.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_MAGNET: A strong magnet pulls the Pokopets away from each other making their distance bigger.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_MIRROR: Turns your opponent's next special ability against themselves.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_POTION: Due to the potion your opponent can't use its boost for a while.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_POWERTHIEF: Takes away your opponent's powers and uses them for you! The opponent becomes slower, whereas your Pokopet becomes faster.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_ROADCRASH: The earth divides and slows down your opponent.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_ROCKYROAD: Places a small rock in front of your opponent.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_RUSHTOVICTORY: A free boost of speed for your Pokopet, totally free!
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_SPEEDRACER: A speedracer pushes your Pokopet forward suddenly.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_SPONGE: Absorbs your opponent's next special skill, and gives it to your Pokopet.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_TELEPORT: Your Pokopet is teleported forward towards the finish line.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_THEFLY: A mean fly makes your opponent hit the brakes.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_TURN: Your opponent gets dizzy and runs to the wrong direction.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_U_CRYFORHELP: Your Stella cries in an unbearable manner. The opponent will forget his goal listening to the sad weeping.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_U_GROVE: Your Woody has the green thumb! Sticks of wood shoot out from the earth and keep your opponent from proceeding.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_U_ROCKET: Your Soque is unstoppable! It turns itself into a rocket and flies over all obstacles!
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_U_SHIELD: Your Cuddle is invincible! It curdles up into a thorny ball, so its opponent can't harm it anymore.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_U_SURFING: Your Helmet is as fast as a storm! He glides forward with his shell in the speed of light.
snippets.PETRACE_TT_SPECIAL_WINGEDCAP: For a short period of time your Pokopet will run a bit faster.
